scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=['../prisma/schema.prisma','../../prisma/schema.prisma'].find((f)=>fs.existsSync(f));if(!p){console.error('Prisma schema not found from current install directory');process.exit(1)}require('child_process').execSync('prisma generate --schema '+p,{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('Azure Functions API: no build step required')"
